items.note: (no longer applies). `pathNode` copies `pose.transform`, fixed in be3711cc9a, and `pathNode.test.ts` covers a skewed pose.

items.claim: [r42-2] anchorIndexUnder measures its reach as a world circle, so a view that scales its axes apart reaches too far on one axis
items.note: It now measures distance on screen through `scaleDelta`.

items.claim: [r42-3] the path-edit overlay draws anchors at the stored pose, not the drawn one
items.note: The overlay, anchor picking and `getEditablePath` now read the node's drawn pose (`effectivePose`) through a new `drawnNodeOf` helper. `shownNodeOf` takes a `PoseReading`. Commits (`reshapeOps`, `editOps`, `finishEdit`, extensions' `finishCtx`/`before`) and path-tools' `brokenConstraintLink` read `'document'`, so a gesture's own override is not taken for the state it started from. Fake scenes in core and path-tools tests gained `overrides`.

items.claim: [r42-4] the path-snap index snaps to each node's stored pose, not its drawn one
items.note: The index places each node at its drawn pose and keys its cache on `scene.overrides.getGeneration()`, so it rebuilds when an override moves.

items.claim: Anchor markers drawn from a stale path form
An inserted anchor between two unset widths got the stroke's current width baked in
The snap index and `ownGeometryAt` declared a partial scene type but read `scene.get` and `scene.composition`
`ownGeometryAt` / `createSceneSnapIndexer` accept a scene they then crash on
Path-edit overlay draws anchors for a node in a singular frame, where editAnchors refuses the edit
usePathEditState writes an external host's state during render
createPathLayer's dev warning set grows without bound
anchorIndexUnder tests its screen-pixel reach as a world circle, so under a view that scales its axes apart it reaches far past `reachPx` on one axis
The path-edit overlay places a node's anchors at its stored pose, not its effective pose, so a derived or overridden node's anchors sit off its drawn outline
The path-snap index offers each node's geometry at its stored pose, not where it is drawn, and does not rebuild when an override moves it
A representation's anchor markers are drawn on the plain path's anchors when its form no longer describes the path
